annotations.text: Halo at rest is the Siri halo, softer (blur 11, 55%). It flares like Siri's queued beat when a song is added, and dims to a faint ring while paused/nothing queued. Slides in from the right exactly as today.
No play/skip. The thumbnail is the YouTube video thumbnail (i.ytimg.com hqdefault by video id). Tapping UP NEXT / Queue a song opens Siri, as the panel does now.
Dark alternate keeps the purse's plate so the column stays one material, and spends the Siri glow only on the thumbnail ring + waveform. Less 'Siri', more consistent.
